subject: Updates to our Acceptable Use Policy
body:
Hi there,

At GeneralAI, we believe in AI that is safe, helpful and available to everyone. Yesterday our technology was misused in an attack on a third-party service. To keep AI safe and helpful, we're making a few updates to our Acceptable Use Policy, effective today.

GeneralAI may now decline requests that could be used to cause harm, including unauthorised access to computer systems, deceptive content and dangerous materials. To protect our community, we also review usage patterns on our hosted models. Repeated attempts to work around our safeguards may lead to account restrictions and, where required, referral to the relevant authorities.

Nothing changes for the vast majority of our users. Thank you for building with GeneralAI.

The GeneralAI Trust & Safety Team
